scope: Coordinator source and isolated synthetic control-flow tests. No TrainerBridge, test runner, README, Actor provider, IPC, release, or game execution changes.

api.identity: Runtime<Identity> has deleted constructor and static state. Start claims the owner once using InterlockedCompareExchange before accessing Observer or other components.
api.start: Start(module, pool, bridgeInstance, confirmedGameThread). The host must independently establish the game thread. Rejects invalid identity, zero instance, overflow, or pool != module + 0x2a17290 before claiming. Does not poll or arm.
api.tick: Tick(budget=1) must keep running on the retained owner, including Fault. Start and later Tick must be separate frames.
api.diagnostic: InspectOnOwner returns a cached diagnostic only after atomic owner-ID and retained-handle checks. Foreign/recycled identity returns Invalid/WrongThread before mutable coordinator reads. sampledInFlight is not current admission evidence.
api.fields: No Journal binding, raw Observer access, Actor-provider callback, native field operation, or IPC authorization is exposed.

start_order: Claim owner, retain own thread HANDLE, store instance
Contract.Prepare and exact five candidate/root mappings into static storage
Contract.Verify(FiveGates), Drain.Begin with stable gate callback/context
Return Bootstrap without Poll or Arm
tick_order: Reject foreign/dead retained owner without component access
In Fault, continue Drain.Poll to service owned resume debt even for an invalid budget
During Bootstrap/Observing, bounded Drain.Poll; debt or drain fault records permanent local Fault
No Observer.Inspect/Fault lock while ResumePending is true
Verify router and full contract; observe Observer health
After Drain.Ready, ArmAfterProvenBarrier on matching instance; active wrapper tickets defer Arm
After Arm, retain owner handles and recheck Drain.Ready; never close drain or reopen initialization
lifetime_and_fault: Bindings seals original trampoline lifetime even if Observer.Bind or later publication fails.
Fault never tears down Router, wrappers, Observer, bound trampolines, registered unwind tables, or retained owner handles.
Fault first records local state. Observer.Fault is delayed until ResumePending is false, preventing an SRW-lock wait on a still-suspended holder.
Before Bindings only, failed original cleanup can be retried by later Fault ticks.
A restored gate never rearms a failed runtime. Typed forwarding remains callable in faulted Observer state.

pool_evidence.anchor: Retail reset caller RVA 0x3c0844 LEA RCX, [module+0x2a17290]; call PoolReset at RVA 0x3c084b.
pool_evidence.limit: Checks the fixed pool address relative to the contract-validated module. Does not claim that pool contents or Actor binding are usable at Start.

production_compile.kind: compile-only real components and all public coordinator APIs; no test macros

covered: Exact prepare/publication/drain sequence; no Start polling or arm
All five independent expected typed targets, original byte arrays, sizes and root ranges
Real Observer bootstrap forwarding during simulated Commit
Completed synthetic drain plus a real active wrapper ticket defers Arm until next Tick
Ten preparation/publication failure stages and permanent singleton claim
Faulted typed candidate targets call each test original exactly once
Repeated synthetic resume failures delay Observer.Fault, with maintenance on invalid budgets
Unpublished cleanup retry; published originals retained
Real own-thread foreign calls are rejected; signaled test owner object models retained-identity rejection
limits: Contract, original batch, router and drain are test doubles in the running suite.
Real Observer/Entrypoints and coordinator thread-handle checks execute, but no native gate or executable trampoline is installed.
No real stack snapshot, suspended-lock scenario, thread-ID reuse, retail module, or end-to-end runtime execution is validated by this suite.
No game process was started, attached to, controlled or modified.

integration_requirements: Host must independently identify the game thread, provide a fresh bridge instance and call outside DllMain and engine/Actor/STATUS metadata locks.

Host must keep ticking Fault until resume debt is repaid. Existing TrainerBridge::OnFrame returns early under g_disabled; future integration must place maintenance where that return cannot suppress it.
Keep the Runtime/module and every published dependency resident until process exit.
Observer-ready alone never authorizes Journal use. Actor generation, actual current role, packed backlink and native destruction/rebinding exclusion remain separate requirements.

Drain/contract support only the researched normal native closure. Arbitrary exception callbacks, custom stack changes, foreign thread control, transient code changes and modified trusted OS/CRT implementations remain outside that proof.
A positive conservative stack scan can defer indefinitely; a timeout must not be converted into successful bootstrap.
No teardown or restart API is provided.
